//devEngines: The version development and CI actually use, as opposed to the minimum `engines` will tolerate. `pnpm/setup` reads it, so the CI workflows name no Node version of their own. The floor is 22.12 because Vite 8 / Rolldown refuse anything older; a bare `22` coerces to 22.0.0 and pnpm then skips their optional native bindings as engine-incompatible.

scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run arch && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
